runtimeEvidenceRules: Use actual Vue/SSR components and actual local APIs with isolated fixture data. Controlled external-provider/network-failure fixtures must be declared; no hardcoded production business results.

Never use/reset preview or production data for testing. Raw cookies/passwords/capabilities/one-time secrets stay outside committed evidence; mask sensitive actual screenshot fields and record redaction selectors without altering business state.
Record every failed command, retry, skip and unavailable branch truthfully. Source-derived or component-harness-only branches are not reported as normal route/runtime success.
